name: Band Standing Hip Extension
steps: Stand tall facing a sturdy wall or chair with a resistance band looped around both ankles.
Lightly rest your hands on the wall for balance and brace your core.
Keeping your target leg straight, slowly extend your leg backward behind you against the resistance of the band.
Squeeze your gluteus maximus firmly at the end-range of extension.
Hold for 1 to 2 seconds at the peak contraction.
Slowly return your leg forward under control.
coaching_cues: Keep your torso upright and do not arch your lower back as your leg kicks back.
Focus all tension directly on the glute rather than your lower back.
Maintain a slight micro-bend in your standing knee for joint comfort.
